basics.name: Sarad Gajurel
basics.label: Lead Software Engineer
basics.summary: Lead Software Engineer with 5+ years building enterprise mobile apps, SaaS platforms, and full-stack web systems. At Pioneer Associate, I lead a team of up to 11 engineers — shipping 100+ white-label mobile banking apps, a multi-method payment platform, ERP systems, and multiple production SaaS products. Stack: Flutter, Node.js, React, Nuxt.js, .NET, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and CI/CD. I also independently publish Android apps on Google Play. Best Team Award (May 2025).

work.summary: Head of Mobile App & Web Services Unit
highlights: Led a cross-functional team of up to 11 engineers across Flutter, Node.js, .NET, and React stacks
Architected CoSys Mobile Banking with 100+ white-label app flavors on a single Flutter codebase, deployed across cooperative banks with CI/CD
Built and shipped SaaS platforms: Restaurant Management (Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker), Waste Management (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker), and Manpower HR System (ASP.NET Blazor, PostgreSQL)
Developed Check Writer — a REST API-driven payment platform supporting checks, eChecks, ACH, credit/debit, wire transfers, and wallet
Established CI/CD pipelines, code standards, and sprint workflows; supervised developers during outstation deployment in India
Awarded Best Team (May 2025) as team lead for exceptional on-time delivery
Blog about programming, new tech trends and tutorials
Develop cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter
Upheld CF worker values: Character, Competence and Community.
Undertook all assigned responsibilities during the working period.
Met project output requirements with regards to speed and accuracy.
Maintained utmost confidentiality with company-wide information.
Attended relevant project meetings including an initial training period.
Attended team meetings and participated in community service projects.
